verdict.rationale: The repository ships its own validation script (`node scripts/validate.mjs`), which checks invocation contracts, retired lifecycle instructions in nested references, and plugin version parity before delivery. That is structural regression checking of the skills. There is no evidence of behavioral tests or evals of skill outputs. The benchmark-yylo skill is a user-facing capability, not evals of this collection, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: behavioral tests/evals of skill outputs, CI enforcement of validation, regression test suites, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection maintains tests or evals for its skills so changes are verified against regressions rather than shipped on vibes

citations.quote: Validate before delivery with `node scripts/validate.mjs`. It checks nested references for retired lifecycle instructions as well as invocation contracts and plugin version parity.
To validate an unpublished checkout without changing your normal settings, use an isolated configuration directory and a local marketplace path
